notes: «قال زهير حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة» : the speaker tag names Zuhayr, already one of the three co-transmitters, so he is not a second link.
The report ends in «ح» with no second branch written; the second route is missing from the text and is not filled.
«أبيه» is the father of سالم, a bare relation (Ibn Umar, not named here); the Prophet is the end of the chain.
